test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I would ______ you to do yoga daily for at least 10 minutes.
solution:
The correct answer is **'advise'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The marked option **'advise' **means to tell someone what they should do.
